snippet.title: Fearless Crew  - Trailer
snippet.description:
Earth is gone. Society runs on the energy of the creatures below, and someone has to go down and catch them. That's you — the cheapest, most expendable crew they could find.

Fearless Crew is a co-op horror creature-catcher for up to 4 players. Hunt mutated monsters, and haul them back to the ship. Every creature needs the right tool to catch.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4644500/Fearless_Crew
